title: Mainframe SDLC Modernization Roadmap
subtitle: Contract, implementation, recovery readiness, and customer migration

entries.label: Current IBM OIO
entries.detail: Current IBM OIO term ends 01/01/2028.

entries.label: Early renewal
entries.detail: Incentivized renewal runs 01/01/2027–12/31/2029.

entries.label: Standard renewal
entries.detail: If early incentives are not compelling, renew for 2028–2030.

entries.label: Next Contract
entries.detail: The early-renewal path requires another contract covering 2030–2033.

entries.label: Tool Discovery
entries.detail: Tool discovery and IBM and Rocket proofs of concept conclude in 2026.

entries.label: Solution Decision
entries.detail: Determine whether the IBM suite is viable; otherwise proceed with Rocket ChangeMan.

entries.label: IDzEE Design
entries.detail: Pull down IDzEE, then configure, design, document, and plan the new SDLC in 2027.

entries.label: DR Planning
entries.detail: Design disaster recovery for GitHub, Artifactory, and DevOps Deploy.

entries.label: Test IBM Debugger
entries.detail: Evaluate IBM Debugger as the InterTest replacement.

entries.label: DR Deployment
entries.detail: Deploy distributed-tool disaster recovery and validate it during biannual exercises through mid-2029.

entries.label: DBB Recovery
entries.detail: Test mainframe DBB recovery and deploy the new SDLC lifecycle environments.

entries.label: Solution Viability
entries.detail: Do we believe in the new DR plan and tested, or do we need to pivot.

entries.label: IBM Migration
entries.detail: Customers begin moving production-ready code into the IBM solution in 2029.

entries.label: ADFz Drawdown
entries.detail: Draw down ADFz in 2030 for File Manager, Fault Analyzer, and Application Performance Analyzer.

entries.label: ADFz Drawdown
entries.detail: Without early renewal, draw down ADFz during the 2028–2030 contract term for File Manager, Fault Analyzer, and Application Performance Analyzer.

entries.label: ChangeMan Setup
entries.detail: Begin ChangeMan development and setup in 2029.

entries.label: Recovery testing
entries.detail: Conduct ChangeMan recovery tests in 2029.

entries.label: Rocket Migration
entries.detail: Customers begin moving code to ChangeMan in 2030.

entries.label: APS conversion
entries.detail: Commercial APS conversion completes by the end of 2029.

entries.label: IBM Migration
entries.detail: Commercial begins moving production-ready code to the IBM solution in 2029.

entries.label: Rocket Migration
entries.detail: Commercial begins moving production-ready code to Rocket ChangeMan in 2030.

entries.label: APS conversion
entries.detail: PGBA APS conversion completes by the end of 2029.

entries.label: IBM Migration
entries.detail: PGBA begins moving production-ready code to the IBM solution in 2029.

entries.label: Rocket Migration
entries.detail: PGBA begins moving production-ready code to Rocket ChangeMan in 2030.
